text: Coffee with Ciara. Her mum's moving in with them sometime next month, which she's a bit anxious about since the house is already tiny. Ciara's gone fully vegan since the summer, so no more cheese boards when she comes over. Her husband Dmitri is not impressed, he's sneaking bacon sandwiches at work. Their eldest has a school trip to Paris in early March.

Long catch-up with Dev on the phone. His brother Theo is getting married May 14 in Lisbon and Dev's best man, absolutely terrified of the speech. Need to send him a couple of funny stories about Theo before the end of the month. Theo's fiancée Yara is vegetarian so the whole wedding menu is meat free, which their dad is already moaning about. Dev's flying out the Wednesday before.

Rin and Aiko came round for dinner. They're off to Hokkaido over the winter holidays, skiing for ten days. Aiko doesn't drink at all, Rin only likes dry white. Their son Duc starts nursery in early March.

Jen mentioned her dad's hip op is booked for 6/3. She's taking the week off to look after him, and her brother Chris is driving down from Leeds for the weekend after. Her dad is diabetic so she's been meal prepping like mad. Jen's clearly stressed but won't admit it. Remind me to check in with her after.
Bumped into Petra outside the bakery. Her daughter's coeliac, just diagnosed, so Petra's learning to bake gluten free from scratch. Seemed tired but fine.
Wiremu called. The housewarming is off, landlord pulled out of the sale. They're staying put till the spring at least.
Gustavo loves proper espresso and hates anything flavoured. Hint for his birthday: he's been eyeing a hand grinder.
Olivia Baker, Liv to everyone, is starting at the hospital sometime next week. Pharmacy role. Her partner Theo is doing the school runs now.

Yuki says Hassan's mum is visiting from Amman for most of November. Hassan wants to take her to the coast, maybe around Nov 20. Yuki's cooking a big meal for her the first weekend, no pork, lots of rice dishes.
Must book the car in for its MOT before the end of the month.
Valentina and Chris celebrated their tenth anniversary last weekend at that tapas place. She said he cried during the toast. Chris is allergic to shellfish so they skipped the paella, ha.
Quick one from lunch with Bethany. Her sister Ellie had the baby on Tuesday, a little girl, Rosa. Bethany's flying up to see them early December. I should get a card for Ellie.
Joe's training for the Brighton half, race is April 12. Knee's been playing up though. He's off booze until then, only drinking that alcohol-free Guinness.
Layla's dog Biscuit went missing yesterday and turned up at a neighbour's this morning. She was in bits. Don't forget to ask Layla how Biscuit's paw is healing.
Bruno told me Duc is leaving the company end of October, going freelance. Leaving drinks probably the Thursday before. Duc only drinks IPA, or so Bruno claims.

Met Dimitri's wife Irina for the first time. She teaches piano, Dimitri does something in logistics. They've got two kids and a cat called Pushkin. Lovely couple, invited us to their place sometime in the new year.
Antoine's mum passed away last week. Funeral is in Lyon on the 28th, he flies out the Sunday before. Need to message Antoine before he goes.
Owen's sitting his driving test again on 11/7. Third attempt. He's properly nervous, keeps saying he'll stall at the roundabout.
Lachlan was going on about his sourdough again. Fourth starter, named it Kevin. He's also gone low-carb, which seems at odds with the sourdough.
Note to self: I'm doing dessert for Miriam's dinner on Saturday. She said Yara's lactose intolerant, so something with no cream. Maybe a fruit crumble with oat milk custard.
Yara's interview at the museum was last Thursday. Should text her to see how it went.

Call with Aiko. Her brother Rin's wife is expecting in the spring, first grandchild on that side. Her parents are over the moon. Aiko's planning a trip back to Osaka for the birth, probably late April.
Ava said Alina's been struggling since the breakup in August. Not sleeping, barely eating. Ava's going to stay with her for a few days next week. I should call Alina at the weekend.
Errands: pick up the dry cleaning, return the drill to Joe's, buy bin bags.
Ciara's husband Dmitri is a chef, very fussy about olive oil. Their kids are 6 and 9. Dmitri's restaurant reopens sometime after Christmas.
Chatted with Hassan after five a side. His daughter has her first piano recital June 3rd, he's way more nervous than she is. He asked if I'd come along.

Petra Novak from work is taking a sabbatical over the summer to walk the Camino. She's been vegetarian for twenty years and is worried about the food in rural Spain. Remind me to lend her my guidebook before she goes.
Ellie's graduation is May 22. Her parents are flying in from Cork. Ellie only eats fish, no meat, so dinner after needs to be somewhere with options.

Rang Gustavo back. His wife Valentina got the promotion to head of department, starts after half term. He's planning a surprise dinner for her sometime mid-November. Wants me there. Valentina hates surprises apparently, so this could go either way.
Theo's cat Mango had surgery on her jaw yesterday. Vet said she'll be on soft food for a couple of weeks. Theo is wrecked, slept at the clinic basically.
Bethany's moving to Manchester early in the new year for her husband's job. Joe's helping with the van. She's sad about leaving her allotment.

Wiremu and his partner Layla are hosting Christmas this year, first time. Wiremu's doing a hangi in the back garden. Layla is gluten free and Wiremu's mum doesn't eat red meat, so there's a lot of chicken and kumara planned.
Dev mentioned his mum's 70th is sometime in March. Big family do. He's thinking of getting her one of those photo books. Must remember to send him the old pics from the reunion.
Joe and Ava are thinking of getting a puppy in the spring. Ava wants a spaniel, Joe wants a greyhound. Ongoing debate.

Spent the afternoon with Irina. Her son Theo got into Edinburgh for medicine, starts in September. She's proud but already dreading the empty house. Theo's allergic to nuts so she's panicking about halls catering. Irina's husband Dmitri is driving him up at the end of the summer. I should send Theo a congrats card.
Lunch with Chris. He's off coffee completely, says it was wrecking his sleep. Drinking rooibos now. Also mentioned his brother Bruno is doing the Edinburgh fringe in August with a stand-up show.
Rin's exams finish around mid-December. Then she goes home to Kyoto for a month. Need to ask Rin for that ramen place recommendation before she leaves.
Miriam's hen do is the weekend of 4/18, somewhere in the Cotswolds. Wedding itself is in June. She's asked me to do a reading.

Duc's wife had a scan on Monday, all clear. They'd been worrying for weeks. Duc's taking her away for a long weekend sometime soon to celebrate, maybe the Lakes. She's off alcohol for a bit anyway so he's planning lots of walking and a fancy tasting menu. Their daughter Aiko is staying with her gran while they're away.

Gym session with Lachlan and Antoine. Antoine's back from Lyon and seems okay, quieter than usual. Lachlan's running the Sydney marathon in late August and has gone fully plant based for it. Should check in with Antoine next week.
Yuki's niece is doing her grade 5 violin exam March 9. Yuki's been driving her to lessons every Saturday. Apparently the kid practises more than Yuki ever did.

Bruno's dad is retiring end of the year after forty years at the docks. Party planned for early January, at the social club probably. Bruno wants to chip in for a fishing rod for him, I said I'd put in twenty. His dad only drinks bitter and refuses anything with coriander, so Bruno's mum is doing the food herself. Bruno's sister Valentina is flying back from Buenos Aires for it.
Owen passed! Driving test went fine in the end. He wants to take everyone for a drive next weekend.

Olivia's sister Petra has her wedding dress fitting on May 2 and Olivia's going with her. Petra's fiancé is vegan so the whole menu is plant based. Olivia is thrilled about that, less thrilled about being maid of honour.
Coffee with Alina, she's doing a bit better. Started a pottery class on Wednesdays. Still not drinking. Her mum's coming to stay over the half term.

Valentina's kids are both obsessed with Taylor Swift right now. Her eldest, Ava, turns 12 on July 7 and is begging for a sleepover party. Valentina's dreading it. The little one has a dairy allergy so the cake has to be dairy free. Gift idea: concert tickets if any come up, or friendship bracelet kit.

Hassan and Yuki are doing the Three Peaks challenge sometime in June. Training most weekends, usually Snowdon or the Brecons. Hassan's knee is the weak point and his physio isn't keen. Yuki's living on flapjacks and electrolyte drinks. They're raising money for the hospice that looked after Yuki's grandad, so I should sponsor them at the end of the month.
Remind me to ring Aiko on the 14th, it's her mum's birthday and she'll want to talk.
Jen's dad is home from hospital now, op went well. Physio twice a week for the next couple of months. Jen sounded relieved. Her dad only drinks decaf tea now, doctor's orders.
Book dentist. Renew passport sometime before March.
Ciara's boss is retiring sometime in the spring and Ciara might go for his job. Interview probably early April. She's quietly confident. Her partner Owen thinks she's a shoo-in.

Talked to Dimitri for ages. His mum has early dementia, they found out over the summer. He's going back to Thessaloniki every few weeks now. He's exhausted. His wife Irina is holding things together. I need to check on Dimitri more often, maybe a call every couple of weeks. And don't forget to ask Irina if they need anything from Costco when I go next Saturday.
Theo says Owen's band has a gig at the Lexington on Dec 5. Owen's on bass. Theo's going, so am I.
Ava's brother Wiremu is back from Melbourne for good, landing sometime the week before Christmas. Ava's throwing a welcome home thing for him. Wiremu's teetotal and a massive foodie.
Petra's daughter Alina got the part of Dorothy in the school play. Shows are the 2nd and 3rd of December. Petra's sewing the costume herself, poor thing.
Gustavo can't eat garlic, it gives him migraines. Noted for when he comes over.
Layla said Wiremu's grandmother turns 90 on August 8. Whole whānau flying in from Rotorua. Wiremu's in charge of the cake, and she only likes lemon.

Yara starts the new job at the museum on 1/12! Curator assistant, exactly what she wanted. Her mum Miriam rang me practically screaming. Yara's a bit nervous about the commute, two trains. I should send her flowers that week, and maybe take her for a drink at the end of the month to celebrate properly.

Ellie and her boyfriend Lachlan are going travelling round Vietnam for three months from early February. Ellie's nervous about the street food because of her peanut allergy. Lachlan's already learning phrases. Need to give Ellie the allergy card translations Duc made.

Big catch-up with Chris and Bethany at the pub. Chris's partner Jen is pregnant, due sometime in May. Bethany's finally finished her PhD, viva was last week and she passed with minor corrections. Both of them drink nothing but cider. I should bring something for Jen's baby shower when it's sorted, probably around April.
